newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rebels kill nine in mine attack in north.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rebels kill nine in mine attack in north.

text.p: Sri Lankan Tamil Tiger guerrillas exploded a landmine in the north on Thursday, killing six soldiers, while troops in the east smashed the second guerrilla base in as many days, military officials said.
The Tigers, hunted in the east by the army who launched an offensive to clear parts of the region from rebel domination, hit back with the landmine attack on troops in the north, they said.
"They exploded a claymore mine under a tractor used by the army, killing six soldiers and three civilians," military spokesman Brigadier Tissa Jayatunga told a news conference in Colombo.
He said the attack occured at densely populated Thirunalveli in the northern Jaffna peninsula, the former rebel stronghold captured by government forces a year ago.

Meanwhile, troops on the offensive in the east smashed another base belonging to the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) guerrillas, who have intensified activity in the region after being driven out of Jaffna in 1996, local officials said.

The base, which was empty at the time, was about three km (1.5 miles) south of Rukam in the eastern Batticaloa district, where troops overran a big training camp the day before killing its 14 rebel occupants, the Ministry of Defence said in a statement.
Troops, backed by aircraft and artillery, launched "Operation Rivijaya" in the early hours of Tuesday to clear separatist bases in the country's east.

The LTTE, who are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the north and east of this Indian Ocean island, was not immediately available for comment on reports of the latest attack.
But the rebels' official newspaper "Eelanadu" said in its Thursday's issue that 19 civilians had fallen victim to troops on the march in the east. The military denied the allegation.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE says the toll is much higher.
